slices.title: Project picker, chip, project thread list
slices.summary: Adds an opt-in Projects section above the chat organizer that lists eligible Spaces (personal Spaces and non-organization rooms), with a project picker, a Space chip, a first-send audience confirm, and a project thread list. Project chats start as new chats, reuse the existing /api/v1/spaces routes, and stay behind GATEWAY_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED (default off).

slices.title: AgentMode vocabulary and resolution seam
slices.summary: Adds the four agent modes (lockdown, read_only, ask_first, auto) with a strictest-wins resolve over the platform floor, the org cap and the user's choice, a pinned golden, and an optional agent_mode field on invoke behind AGENT_MODES. With no choice the request is byte-identical; an unknown mode is refused with agent_mode_unknown; the chat client sends the mode, and the action contract is registered first.
